abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Overcoming the immunosuppressive microenvironment of pancreatic cancer (PC) using oncolytic viruses appears to be a promising therapeutic approach. However, tumor cells are characterized by significant heterogeneity, including populations of resistant cells with high basal JAK/STAT signaling activity. One potential approach to overcoming this resistance is the use of JAK1/2 kinase inhibitors, such as ruxolitinib, the efficacy of which has already been demonstrated in several studies.
OBJECTIVE: To study the effect of ruxolitinib (a JAK1/2 kinase inhibitor) on the replicative activity of certain oncolytic flaviviruses (YFV 17D) and alphaviruses (SINV K1487) in human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell lines AsPC-1, BxPC-3, and Capan-2, which are characterized by high resistance to viral oncolysis.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell lines: AsPC-1, BxPC-3, and Capan-2 from the collection of Laboratory of Tick-Borne Encephalitis Chumakov FSC R&D IBP RAS (Institute of Poliomyelitis). Viruses: yellow fever virus strain 17D and Sindbis virus strain K1487 (GenBank AC № PZ244961.1). Virus quantification was performed using the plaque assay on Vero cell culture and real-time PCR.
RESULTS: In this study, we investigated the effect of ruxolitinib (a JAK1/2 kinase inhibitor) on the replicative activity of certain oncolytic flaviviruses (YFV 17D) and alphaviruses (SINV K1487) in virus-resistant human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell lines AsPC-1, BxPC-3, and Capan-2. A significant dose-dependent increase in infectious titers (by 2-3 orders of magnitude) of YFV 17D and SINV K1487 was demonstrated in the studied cultures in the presence of various concentrations of ruxolitinib (0.1 μM, 0.5 μM, 1.0 μM, and 5.0 μM).
CONCLUSION: Enhanced replication of oncolytic flaviviruses and alphaviruses in the presence of ruxolitinib could significantly improve the efficacy of therapy for resistant and highly immunosuppressive pancreatic cancer. This combined virotherapy approach can activate powerful immunomediated cell death mechanisms even without an overt cytopathic effect in culture.

인간 췌장암 세포주인 AsPC-1, BxPC-3, Capan-2가 실험에 사용되었습니다.
ruxolitinib의 농도는 0.1 μM, 0.5 μM, 1.0 μM, 5.0 μM로 다양하게 적용되었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌장암(pancreatic cancer, PC)의 저항성을 극복하기 위해 JAK1/2 억제제인 ruxolitinib이 종양용해성 바이러스의 복제에 미치는 영향을 조사했습니다. 바이러스 저항성을 가진 인간 췌장암 세포주인 AsPC-1, BxPC-3, Capan-2를 대상으로 황열병 바이러스(yellow fever virus) 균주인 YFV 17D와 신디스 바이러스(Sindbis virus) 균주인 SINV K1487을 사용했습니다. 연구 결과, ruxolitinib 처리에 따라 감염성 티터(titer)가 용량 의존적으로 2~3 자릿수 증가하는 것이 확인되었습니다. 이는 ruxolitinib과의 병용 요법이 내성을 가진 췌장암 치료의 효과를 향상시킬 수 있음을 시사합니다.
title: Enhancement of oncolytic flavi- and alphavirus replication in resistant human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell lines using ruxolitinib
title_ko: ruxolitinib를 이용한 내성 인간 췌장암 세포주에서의 종양용해성 플라비바이러스 및 알파바이러스 복제 증진
